521:t_110:2.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You fool, taken in by $$シャア$$'s smooth talk!」

521:t_110:3.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「The Colonel has nothing to do with it anymore! I'm taking down $$フロンタル$$ and you by my own will!」

521:t_110:4.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「If you can't understand that, go be $$フロンタル$$'s lapdog for the rest of your life!」

521:t_111:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Proto $$プルトゥエルブ$$... I'm told your data was useful in my completion, too.」

521:t_111:2.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「But in the end, you are prototypes. I can tell that your limit is drawing near.」

521:t_111:3.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Even so...! Even so, I will fight!」

521:t_111:4.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「That is the selfishness the Master allowed me!」
